description: Indryk, the king of all beasts from Slavic legends, a huge majestic beast like a grey-white horse and bull in one, a single long spiral horn on its forehead, a shaggy mane, stamping its cloven hooves so that springs of water burst up around them, glowing eyes, menacing, standing on four legs, full body, three-quarter view, the beast alone, no ground, no background, the whole beast inside the picture
